Open items where we need direction from your side:

- Any insurance/PO requirement from your procurement team? We typically accept PO + standard commercial insurance limits, but want to confirm.

If useful I can loop in our legal (Karthik) and privacy (Neha) for a short call — what does your availability look like Thursday morning?

Best,

Date: Thu, 4 Nov 2027 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: FINBRIDGE — DPA redlines + SOC2 access (need legal/privacy review)

Team — forwarding FinBridge request and our proposed redline. Two items I want quick guidance on before I push the doc back:
1) Retention/export: FinBridge's MSA wants broader export timelines. Our redline (see section 4) tightens export to 90 days for customer data; business telemetry 12 months. Neha, confirm this is compliant with our standard PD policy and SCCs.
2) Subprocessor transparency: they requested an explicit list in the contract rather than a dynamic list. Karthik, can we accept a dynamic published list + 30 days' notice rather than enumerating subs in the contract?

Karthik replied (inline):
> Marissa — I reviewed sections 3.1 and 4. We should hold firm on the 90-day export window for customer-controlled data. For telemetry, 12 months is reasonable but add opt-out language for customers who need shorter retention. On subprocessors, accept dynamic list + 30 days notice, but add a right to object clause for critical subprocessors. I can draft two short clauses.

Neha (privacy) responded:
> Confirmed — retention windows are in line with our baseline. For SCCs: we support using the EU Commission SCCs + modular addendum; we'll include a note about transfer mechanisms in the DPA preamble.

Vanessa added:
> I'll coordinate procurement for insurance thresholds. If they want higher limits, we'll escalate to finance.

Please advise if you want me to incorporate Karthik's suggested language and re-send to Aliyah for signature routing. I can also open a short 30-min sync with FinBridge tomorrow at 10am PT.

--
Marissa
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Subject: Final DPA and signature path (FinBridge / Redwood)

Aliyah — thanks for the patience. Attached is the finalized DPA incorporating the legal/privacy feedback. Summary of key points and next steps:

- Retention: 90 days for customer-controlled exports; 12 months for telemetry with an opt-out clause.
- Subprocessors: dynamic published list + 30 days' notice; right to object language added for critical subprocessors.
- SCCs: we will execute on the EU Commission SCCs (modular addendum) where applicable.

Attachments included: FinBridge_DPA_Redlines_20271103.docx (clean + tracked), Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2026-summary.pdf, CAIQ-l1-summary.xlsx.

DocuSign link to start execution: https://www.docusign.com/sign/abc123-finbridge (routing: Redwood Legal (Karthik) -> FinBridge Legal (Aliyah) -> Redwood Sales Ops (Vanessa) -> FinBridge exec if needed).

Please confirm you are good with the final redlines and I'll kick off DocuSign. If you prefer a short call to review one last point (retention language), happy to jump on 30 minutes now or tomorrow morning.
